verdict: Leads at record efficiency; pipeline intake needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 139 leads at a cost per lead of $12.85 — the strongest efficiency on record and well below the $19–45 range seen in July. The volume surge is real: leads jumped nearly 30% in the most recent 7-day stretch versus the prior 7 days. However, 139 leads arriving from ads against 120 contacts in your CRM and zero opportunities created points to a gap in how incoming leads are being processed — this is an intake issue, not an advertising issue. We are working to close that gap now so leads already in the system are not left idle. A drop in Google Business Profile activity this week is also being addressed to protect your organic visibility heading into next period.

leads received this period, up nearly 30% in the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not entering your pipeline — 139 received, zero opportunities created in the CRM.
watch_item.fix: We are closing the intake gap now to ensure every incoming lead is logged and moved forward.
